category_edits.rationale: Align learned positions by recency across all four datasets: the latest visible interaction receives position zero. Preserve context length, chronological ordering, causal masking, embedding dimensions, backbone, readout, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports the same model and checks positional metadata.

edits.find: - Official SASRec positional encoding: positions 0..maxlen-1 with padding masked after dropout
edits.replace: - Recency-aligned positional encoding: latest visible token at position zero, with padding masked after dropout

        pos = pos.masked_fill(seq.eq(0), 0)
        seq_emb = seq_emb + self.pos_emb(pos)
